snippet.title: The Mine Song But It's In A Playable Doom WAD
snippet.description:
Oh yes I did. I made a joke WAD based on the meme on "The Mine Song" from LazyTown, as the song is aside other memes based on LazyTown songs. It also took me one week to make this. In the WAD, you can battle Stingy, and there are plenty of surprises in the WAD as well. GZDoom is also recommended, or any other source port that runs OpenGL.

Go here to get the WAD (the link is on the bottom of the page):
https://sites.google.com/site/nitroactivestudios/projects/the-mine-song-but-it-s-in-a-playable-doom-wad

Go here for the Doomworld Forums thread about it:
https://www.doomworld.com/vb/wads-mods/92822-the-mine-song-but-its-in-a-playable-doom-wad/

Credits:
Music: "Carnival Theme" from Dark Seed II (PC)
"The Mine Song" from LazyTown
"The Mine Song" MIDI: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=flOMvuI8l38
Custom Enemy Created and Coded By: Nambona890 of YouTube
Dramatic Sound Effect From: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=fbDFAaPfl28
Stingy and LazyTown Created By: Magnús Scheving
Movie Made With: Sony Vegas Pro 12.0
